# ezghcloud_cdn_distribution (Resource)

A CDN distribution: serves its default hostname and your own domains over HTTPS from locations near your visitors, and forwards each request to one origin. CNAME each domain to default_hostname.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Serve www.example.com over HTTPS from locations near its visitors, in front of a load balancer.
# Then CNAME www.example.com to ezghcloud_cdn_distribution.web.default_hostname.
resource "ezghcloud_cdn_distribution" "web" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "web"

  origin = {
    host = "shop-lb.example.com"
  }

  domain {
    hostname       = "www.example.com"
    certificate_id = ezghcloud_certificate.web.id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, 1 to 100 characters.
- `origin` (Attributes) Where requests go. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--origin))
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier. Changing it replaces the distribution.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 1,000 characters; null clears it.
- `domain` (Block List) One of your own domains, at most 10. Attaching its certificate needs certificates.certificates.use on it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--domain))
- `enabled` (Boolean) false keeps the distribution and serves nothing for it. Defaults to true.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `default_hostname` (String) d<12>.ezghcdn.com: the hostname it serves at once, and the CNAME target of its domains. Never changes.
- `id` (String) Distribution ID (cdn_).
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) deploying after every change until every location has it, then deployed.

<a id="nestedatt--origin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `origin`

Required:

- `host` (String) A hostname or IPv4 address on the internet, in lowercase. Private, loopback and EZGH platform addresses are refused.

Optional:

- `host_header` (String) The Host header the origin gets: viewer (the visitor's) or origin (host). Defaults to viewer.
- `port` (Number) 1 to 65535. Defaults to 443 for https and 80 for http.
- `protocol` (String) https or http. With https the origin's certificate must be valid for host. Defaults to https.


<a id="nestedblock--domain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domain`

Required:

- `certificate_id` (String) A Web Certificates certificate (crt_) in the same project that covers hostname.
- `hostname` (String) An exact hostname (www.example.com) or a one-label wildcard (*.example.com), in lowercase. One distribution serves a hostname at a time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_cdn_distribution.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/cdn_ID'
```
